text:
QUOTE: `HealthMonitor::process_events` swaps the event queue out under `event_mutex_` and runs callbacks after releasing it. Callbacks therefore run on the engine thread without holding the lock.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that events are queued under `event_mutex_` and that `process_events` drains them and runs callbacks on the engine (caller) thread rather than the monitor thread.
